plugins.name: ng
plugins.description: Angular development assistant — generate, review, test and migrate Angular apps following an opinionated, production-proven structure

skills.name: angular-generate
skills.description: Generate Angular artifacts (components, services, pipes, directives, guards, interceptors, routes, stores). Use automatically when the user asks to create any Angular code, scaffold a feature, or add a new file to an Angular project. Mirrors Angular CLI conventions.
skills.description_zh: 按照 Angular CLI 约定生成组件、服务、pipe、指令、guard、interceptor、路由和 store，用于新增代码或搭建功能骨架。

skills.name: angular-migration
skills.description: Migrate deprecated Angular patterns to modern equivalents. Auto-invoked when editing NgModule files or using deprecated APIs.
skills.description_zh: 将已弃用 Angular 模式迁移为现代等价写法，适用于 NgModule 文件和弃用 API 修改。

skills.name: angular-performance
skills.description: Angular performance patterns — OnPush, signals, defer, lazy loading, virtual scroll. Auto-invoked when reviewing or optimizing Angular code.
headings: Signals over observables for local state
skills.description_zh: 审阅优化 Angular 性能，应用 OnPush、signals、defer、懒加载及虚拟滚动模式。

skills.name: angular-rxjs
skills.description: RxJS patterns in Angular — operators, signals interop, cleanup, and common recipes. Auto-invoked when using observables in Angular files.
skills.description_zh: 提供 Angular 的 RxJS 操作符、signals 互操作、清理和常见用法，支持 observable 代码。

skills.name: angular-testing
skills.description: Write Angular unit tests. Use automatically when creating .spec.ts files, when asked to test Angular components/services/pipes/directives/guards, or when reviewing test coverage. Supports Jest and Jasmine/Karma. Mirrors Angular testing documentation.
headings: Before Writing Tests — Detect Test Runner
skills.description_zh: 编写审阅 Angular 单元测试及 .spec.ts，覆盖组件、服务、pipe、指令和 guard，支持 Jest、Jasmine/Karma 并参考 Angular 测试文档。

skills.name: ngrx-patterns
skills.description: NgRx best practices for actions, reducers, selectors, and effects. Auto-invoked when working with NgRx store files.
skills.description_zh: 提供 NgRx actions、reducers、selectors 和 effects 的实践，适用于状态存储文件开发。

commands.name: docs
commands.description: Generate TSDoc comments and documentation for Angular code. Usage: /ng:docs [file-path]

commands.name: generate
commands.description: Generate Angular artifacts following the opinionated project structure. Usage: /ng:generate [type] [name] [path?] Types: component, service, pipe, directive, guard, interceptor, routes, store Mirrors Angular CLI (ng generate) conventions.

commands.name: migrate
commands.description: Migrate Angular patterns to modern equivalents. Usage: /ng:migrate [type] [path?]

commands.name: review
commands.description: Review Angular code for best practices, performance, and correctness. Checks components, services, templates, routing, NgRx, and RxJS patterns. Flags anti-patterns with specific fix suggestions.

commands.name: store
commands.description: Scaffold a complete NgRx feature store. Usage: /ng:store [feature-name] [path?]

commands.name: test
commands.description: Generate unit tests for an Angular file. Usage: /ng:test [file-path]
